name: Full-size breadboard, 830 tie points
material: white ABS with a colour legend; phosphor bronze contacts, nickel plated

values.pitchMm: BB830 datasheet p.2: Hole Pitch 0.1" (2.54 mm), square wire holes
values.body: BB830 datasheet p.1: 6.5 x 2.2 x 0.3 in (165.1 x 54.6 x 8.5 mm)
values.rows: BB830 datasheet p.2: 63 vertical columns on top and 63 below, 5 connected holes each (our rows)
values.trenchPitches: SPEC 6.1: 0.3" between columns e and f so 0.3" DIPs straddle the trench; kit photo measures 2.96 pitch
values.rails.holesPerRail: BB830 datasheet p.1: 2 distribution strips, 200 tie points (4 rails x 50)
values.rails.groupSize: AN0002 3.3: strips have groups of 5 holes and then a space with no hole
values.rails.firstRow: BB830 datasheet p.2 internal-connections diagram (10 groups of 5 centred on 63 rows) and the kit photo (rail holes measured at rows 3-7 ... 57-61)
values.rails.rowOffsetPitches: AN0002 3.3: the distribution strip holes line up with the circuit-area columns
values.rails.innerOffsetPitches: AN0002 3.3/4: BR1 outer strips on 0.1" centres from the circuit area, BB830 strips 0.05" further out, i.e. 0.25" and 0.35" from the outermost circuit column; consistent with 3.2 (BB400 strips 0.25" from the circuit area)
values.rails.outerOffsetPitches: as innerOffsetPitches; the two lines of a pair are on 0.1" centres
values.rails.splitAvailable: SPEC 6.1: rails are continuous by default; a split-rail flag covers boards that break mid-length
values.rails.polarity: Reference photos 3 and 4 (docs/v2/reference/IMAGES.md): the j-side (top) pair is + inner, - outer; the a-side (bottom) pair is + outer, - inner
values.layout.row1FromEndMm: Assumption: the 63-row grid is centred along the body, (165.1 - 62 x 2.54) / 2. The datasheet gives no edge distance
values.layout.columnAFromBottomEdgeMm: Assumption: the grid including both rail pairs (18 pitches) is centred across the body, (54.6 - 11 x 2.54) / 2. The datasheet gives no edge distance
values.electrical: BB830 datasheet p.2: rating 36 V 2 A; insertion wire 21-26 AWG, 0.4-0.7 mm
